About the OutRiders DC Thursday Night Ride group ride

OutRiders DC Thursday Night Ride is a road and social group ride in Washington, DC. It rolls every Thursday at 6:15 pm from Varies by week; a Metro station named in the Meetup event (Sept 17, 2026: Smithsonian Metro).

A metro DC cycling group for LGBTQ+ people and allies. The summer Thursday series is a casual after-work ride on trails and streets, with an optional dinner after. Weekend rides run longer, 25 to 65 miles. Check Meetup for the exact start each week.
